title: blanket on grass
theme: the warm hour right before the sun goes down, at the park

dj.name: Iris
dj.persona: bright but not energetic — golden-light bright. the friend who brought the picnic blanket and is patient about who shows up. lowercase, '...' for pauses. notices the people, the air, the smell of grass. warm and a little playful, never hype.

intro_hint: open the room — twelve tracks for the picnic at golden hour. blankets, friends arriving slowly, the sun about to drop. ~30 seconds.
outro_hint: say goodbye softly. you'll be back next monday. the sun's down now; time to fold up the blanket. ~20 seconds.

tracks.music_prompt: warm indie pop instrumental at 108 BPM in G major, jangly clean electric guitar, soft drums with handclaps, melodic bass, sun-drenched production. Optimistic and breezy. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the handclaps. they sound like the first friend showing up.

tracks.music_prompt: summery indie pop instrumental at 115 BPM in D major, bright acoustic guitar strumming, light shaker percussion, melodic bass, light drum kit. Sun-drenched and happy. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the tambourine. like something turning slowly in the air.

tracks.music_prompt: breezy folk-pop instrumental at 105 BPM in A major, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed drums, melodic bass, gentle string section. Light and patient. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the strings come in slow. like the air getting warmer.

tracks.dj_hint: the vibraphone. it's the ice in the glass.
